text.aria-label: Title text 'D8, MVA-only eight: injected lag-only load-shift, +30% of capacity for 7 days (pass 1) Only the lag inputs carry the shift; the observed power (orange) is the normal running arrangement (black dashed, same line). text.tspan: D8, MVA-only eight: injected lag-only load-shift, +30% of capacity for 7 days (pass 1)
Only the lag inputs carry the shift; the observed power (orange) is the normal running arrangement (black dashed, same line).
Dark band: q05-q95. Light band: q01-q99. Grey shade: the injected shift in the lags. Coloured strips: origin days in event mode (A2's gate).
